title: Grill telemetry integration
details: Accepted the first genuine telemetry contract. Aggregate whole-system CPU from Mach HOST_CPU_LOAD_INFO is the default terrain source; explicit `--synthetic` remains. Decisions 0006 through 0008, PROJECT.md, DESIGN.md, and research evidence are synchronized. Approved implementation order: build the telemetry pipeline in isolation, then connect it to terrain and presentation.
